title: stardust import/<archetype>/vocabulary.json and transform.json
description: The per-template map of the shipped sibling encoder (migrate/scripts/encode.mjs). vocabulary.json validates against this schema's root, transform.json against #/$defs/transform. The contract the encoder applies is its own validators (encode/engine.mjs validateVocabulary and validateTransform); this schema documents the same keys, and test/encode-lint.test.mjs keeps the two in step. Keys marked x-lint are read by `encode.mjs --lint` only; the engine passes them through. Every selector is evaluated by encode/dom.mjs (tag, #id, .class, [attr op value], combinators, :scope :not :is :where :has :first-child :last-child :first-of-type :empty) and is taken from the committed archetype capture. `--lint` (C1) rejects generated ids and class tokens, position pseudo-classes outside a row group's or a cell's selector (position among a module's own rows and items is its structure), classes found on no capture of the template (prototype classes, the eds-schema unitSelector) and chains through layout wrappers.

$comment.description: free text for the map's author. Every object of the map takes $comment and only the keys documented here: the engine rejects any other key

archetype.description: the template's archetype slug (representativeSlug in stardust/rollout/coverage/templates.json); --lint fails when it names another page

root.description: the content root (rule 5): never body, html or a chrome landmark

chrome.description: removed before the walk: header, footer, breadcrumb …

wrappers.description: layout containers the walk recurses through (rule 4); a marker never chains through one

moduleSelectors.description: what a component is: a visible match with no marker is `unmapped`, one inside rich content is `flattened`. Default: [data-module] [data-component] [data-tpl] [data-block]

sectionTags.description: tags that open and close a section of their own

walkSiblings.description: also walk the root's following siblings, up to the first footer/nav/header landmark

requireH1.description: a page without an <h1> stops as `error`

ignoreModifiers.description: class-token regexes the shape fingerprint ignores (layout-grid classes, modifiers that never become a token); generated tokens are always ignored

metadata.description: the metadata block's rows, in order. Default: Title $title, Description $description, nav $nav, footer $footer

markers.description: what each source module is. Array order is the only precedence: the first marker matching the element itself wins (rule 3); --lint (C3) wants each module matched by exactly one

selector.description: a CSS selector over the capture (encode/dom.mjs)

$comment.description: free text for the map's author

sha.description: sha256 of the file's bytes when the map was last checked against it

inputs.description: what the map was authored and last linted against. --lint fails while a recorded sha differs from the file (re-check the map, then record the new sha it prints) and while an existing input is not recorded; a recorded optional input that is missing is only a note

$comment.description: free text for the map's author

capture.description: stardust/current/pages/<archetype>.html — the authority for every selector

edsSchema.description: stardust/eds-schema/<archetype>.json — roles and cell order only (C6)

variance.description: a kept sibling-variance JSON: which siblings need a token, never selector text

childClass.description: an element with an element child whose class token matches (a wrapper around a component); anchor it on the block class, e.g. ^x-[a-z]+(-[a-z]+)*$, so element and modifier classes never match

class.description: an element whose own class token matches

prefixItems.description: alternatives joined by ||, the first non-empty wins: a template over $title $description $nav $footer $h1 $ogtitle, or text(<selector>) on the capture; an alternative with neither is a literal (recorded)

variance.description: reviewed shape differences: a sibling whose set of shape prints differs from the archetype's stops as `variance` unless the difference is accepted here

$comment.description: free text for the map's author
free text for the map's author

print.description: the exact print the encoder reported

on.description: extra: a sibling carries it and the archetype does not; missing: the reverse

$comment.description: free text for the map's author

class.description: ancestor class tokens left out of every print's ancestor chain

emitter.description: block:<name>[ <variant>…] · default-content · wrapper · section (with style) · section-style:<style> · section-break:<style> (an empty styled section) · drop:<reason> · dynamics:<row>. Absent or null: a known kind not mapped yet, `unmapped` when visible (there is no "none")

$comment.description: free text for the map's author

sel.description: matched against the element itself, never a descendant search

kind.description: the module's name in reports (default: sel)

style.description: the section style of a `section` emitter

sectionBefore.description: close the current section before this module

sectionAfter.description: close the current section after this module

variants.description: block variant tokens predicted by the source DOM; the token names come from the gated archetype document (C5)

merge.description: adjacent runs of the same block merge into one block, one row per run (rule 10)

drop.description: left out of this module (never counted as missing content)

evidence.description: sibling slugs this marker was widened from; a marker with no hit on the archetype must hit each of them

unique.description: matches at most once per page (the h1 title, a page container)

$comment.description: free text for the map's author

when.description: matched against the module element; always from the source DOM

add.description: the token(s) added to the block's class

anyOf.description: one row per match, with the marker's cells

rows.description: absent: the module is one row. With a stardust/replica/units.json family, rows select exactly the family's origin units (C4)

$comment.description: free text for the map's author

sel.description: absent: the module itself is the row

optional.description: a group that matches nothing is not `flattened`

cells.description: a row's cells in order; their order agrees with the eds-schema roles (C6)

each.description: one cell per match: a variable-width row

cellSpecKeys.description: a required cell that resolves to nothing is `flattened`

$comment.description: free text for the map's author

sel.description: relative to the row; absent: the row itself

as.description: a mode the grammar lacks is a hard stop, never a per-template extension

all.description: use every match (default: true for rich, else the first)

itemWrap.description: wraps each matched node's value before join

optional.description: true: the cell may be left out; "empty": an empty cell stands in

selfOk.description: the row itself may be the match

attr.description: attr: the attribute read; idref: the attribute holding the id (default aria-labelledby); link: the attribute holding the URL (an iframe's src)

then.description: idref: how the referenced node renders

text.description: link: the label inside the anchor

titleAttr.description: link: the attribute that becomes the link title

parts.description: a compound cell, each part relative to the matched node; exclusive with as

$comment.description: free text for the map's author

imageParagraph.description: a block-level image is wrapped in

emptyP.description: drop also drops a div or span holding only whitespace or NBSP
